##IMPORTS
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(fpp3)
library(slider) #for rolling window functions
library(gt)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

```


##Load the data
```{r}
data <- read_csv("~/USD/Applied Time Series/Final Project/residential_electricity.csv")
```
##Convert to tsibble
```{r}

electric <- data |>
  transmute(Month = yearmonth(date), Value = residential_million_kwh) |>
  as_tsibble(index = Month)
```
##Train test split
```{r}
TR <- electric |>
  filter(Month <= yearmonth("2025 Jan"), Month >= yearmonth("2010 Jan"))

test <- electric |>
  filter(Month >= yearmonth("2025 Jan"), Month <= yearmonth("2026 July"))
```
#First glance
```{r}
electric|> autoplot()
```
#Transformed Data
```{r}
electric_log <- electric |>
    mutate(
        log_v = log(Value),
        d1 = difference(log_v, lag = 1)
    )
```


#Log Transformed Data
```{r}
electric_log |>
    autoplot(log_v)
```

#Evaluating log-transformed, differenced training data
```{r}
electric_log |>
    autoplot(d1)
```
#tranform training data
```{r}
train <- TR |>
    mutate(
        #log transform data
        log_v = log(Value),
#difference training data
        d1 = difference(log_v, lag = 1)
    )
```

#TSLM - auto
```{r}
TSLM_fit <- train |>
  model(tslm = TSLM(d1 ~ trend() + season())) 

report(TSLM_fit)
```
#TSLM - auto -unmodified
```{r}
#TSLM - auto -unmodified
TSLM_fit_unmodified <- TR |>
  model(tslm = TSLM(Value ~ trend() + season())) 

report(TSLM_fit_unmodified)
```

#noise test
```{r}
TSLM_fit |>
    augment() |>
    autoplot(.innov)
```
#Residual plot
```{r}
TSLM_fit |>
    gg_tsresiduals(type = "innovation")
```
#Ljung-Box test
```{r}
dof_tslmf <- nrow(tidy(TSLM_fit_unmodified))

TSLM_fit_unmodified |>
    augment() |>
    features(.innov, list(ljung_box = ljung_box, box_pierce = box_pierce), lag = 12, dof = 6) |>
    select(contains("pvalue") | contains("stat"))

n <- nrow(TR)
tibble(
    model = c("TSLM", "TSLM Unmodified"),
    coefficients = c(nrow(tidy(TSLM_fit)), nrow(tidy(TSLM_fit_unmodified))),
    residual_df = n - coefficients
)
```
#noise test
```{r}
TSLM_fit_unmodified |>
    augment() |>
    autoplot(.innov)
```
#Residual plot
```{r}
TSLM_fit_unmodified |>
    gg_tsresiduals(type = "innovation")
```
#Ljung-Box test
```{r}
dof_tslm <- nrow(tidy(TSLM_fit))

TSLM_fit |>
    augment() |>
    features(.innov, list(ljung_box = ljung_box, box_pierce = box_pierce), lag = 12, dof = dof_tslm) |>
    select(contains("pvalue") | contains("stat"))
```
#Forecasting both TSLM on transformed data and original data
```{r}
bind_rows(
    fc |>
        filter(.model == "unmodified") |>
        accuracy(test) |>
        select(.model, RMSE, MAE, MAPE),
    diff_pred |>
        left_join(test |> select(Month, Value), by = "Month") |>
        summarise(
            RMSE = sqrt(mean((Value - .fitted)^2)),
            MAE = mean(abs(Value - .fitted)),
            MAPE = mean(abs(Value - .fitted) / Value) * 100,
            .by = .model
        )
)
```



#Decomposition

```{r}
decomp_fit <- electric |>
  model(stl = STL(Value))

components(decomp_fit) |>
  autoplot()
```

```{r}
fc_unmod <- fc |>
  filter(.model == "unmodified") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(Month, .model, .mean)

curves <- bind_rows(fc_unmod, fc_diff |> select(Month, .model, .mean))

actual <- electric |>
  filter(Month >= yearmonth("2022 Jan")) |>
  as_tibble()

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = actual, aes(x = Month, y = Value), colour = "black") +
  geom_line(data = curves, aes(x = Month, y = .mean, colour = .model), linewidth = 1.2) +
  labs(
    y = "Total Electricity Sales (Millions of Kilowatthours)",
    title = "Forecasts vs. Actual",
    subtitle = "Training: Jan 2010 to Jan 2025, holdout: Jan 2025 to Jul 2026"
  )

```
